turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My phone finally died, and I'm choosing between a few replacements.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is the latest flagship with an amazing camera, but it costs over a thousand dollars.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's last year's model of the same phone, almost as good and a few hundred cheaper.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a mid range phone with a huge battery that lasts two full days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a small compact phone that fits easily in my pocket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What bugged you most about your old phone? If it was the battery, the mid range phone is a clear win. If you take lots of photos, go with last year's flagship.
